title: GalaxyGeneralRobotics/LATENT official partial implementation
summary: Official snapshot exposing motion preprocessing, G1 tennis tracker training, playback, evaluation, and export. The README marks DAgger distillation, the latent model, high-level tennis training, and sim-to-real design as unreleased. Inspected only, not vendored.
license: NOASSERTION at project root; bundled assets retain separate terms

metadata.release_boundary: Tracker and a small motion subset only; DAgger, latent model, high-level tennis policy, and sim-to-real design are TODOs.
metadata.redistribution: No code, model, motion, dataset, configuration, or robot asset is copied.
